title: Crash with special objects in plugins

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: problem that needs to be addressed

body:
Having objects in conftest that cannot have getattr called causes pytest to crash.

Here is a small example that shows this:

conftest.py:

``` python
class DontTouchMe:
    def __getattr__(self, x):
        raise Exception('cant touch me')

x = DontTouchMe()
```

This happens in practice with django settings (`django.conf.settings`) that must not be touched until Django is properly configured: https://github.com/pytest-dev/pytest-django/issues/272
